description: This file implements a class and functions for traversing an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to identify constant expressions with specific precision qualifiers and hoist them as named variables for correct precision propagation in shader code compilation.

classes.name: RecordConstantPrecisionTraverser
classes.description: A class derived from TIntermTraverser that traverses AST nodes to identify constant unions with higher precision qualifiers and hoist them as variables.

methods.name: RecordConstantPrecision
methods.description: Main function that performs iterative traversal and modification of the AST to record constant precision qualifiers.
